summary: Fixed lifecycle wrapper unmount ordering so a core-refused completion-time reentrant unmount no longer retires the effect driver or cancels pending callbacks. Immediate core disposal retires effects synchronously; deferred core disposal is detected after the active admission unwinds through a coalesced microtask. Added actual compiled-fixture regressions for rejected and deferred unmount, subsequent request/reply delivery, and callback release.

pre_fix_regression.failure: Expected the pending parent request to remain, but the old wrapper had retired it before core refused the nested unmount.

coverage: Completion Proxy ownKeys reentry receives false from runtime.unmount and leaves state, trace, pending correlations, and callbacks unchanged.
A later Go request and both the pre-existing and new request completions are accepted after the refused unmount.
A core-deferred unmount retires the request callback after the current dispatch and core deferred queue finish.
A direct accepted unmount continues to retire outstanding effect correlations.

limits: The cross-profile React/DOM browser matrix must be rerun against the final frozen lifecycle wrapper source.
No shared compiled runtime source was changed; the core file hash is preserved from the accepted R-EFFECT-SLICE packet.
